summary: iter441 regression for P0 daily-report draft-loss remediation. Authored 6 new tests at /app/backend/tests/pw_suite/test_draft_loss_regression_iter440.py covering (a) sibling forms (NewIncident/NewInspection/HrPayrollVariance/AdminDlsDay1Debrief) mount without crash after useFormDraft hook signature widened, (b) idempotency key persistence round-trip in IDB across reload, (c) end-to-end telemetry POSTing — typing on /daily/submit emits draft.write.ok events to /api/draft-telemetry, verified via admin /recent feed. Ran the full P0 regression suite (20 tests across 3 files: this new file + iter440 backend endpoint + iter440 client remediation) on mobile viewport 390x844 — 20/20 PASS. All declared features and bugs from the review request verified.

integration_issues.flow: draft telemetry on /daily/submit when foreman has NO portal token
integration_issues.issue: draftTelemetry.js::_tokenHeader() returns null if no admin/pm/hr/safety/dispatch/leadership/shop token is in localStorage. _postBatch() then early-returns without flushing the buffer. In production, foremen accessing /daily/submit via public link (the exact P0 population) will accumulate events in the in-memory ring (cap 200) that NEVER reach /api/draft-telemetry. Telemetry was created specifically to monitor this population — so the observability gap remains. Suggest either (1) granting /api/draft-telemetry a public POST mode keyed by deviceId rate-limit, or (2) issuing a short-lived public telemetry token to /daily/submit on first visit.

action_items: Consider closing the public-mode telemetry gap (see frontend_issues.integration_issues) so foremen on /daily/submit emit draft.write.ok / draft.write.fail to the backend. This is the very population the P0 incident affected; today telemetry only fires when a portal token coexists in localStorage.
Optional: add a unit test that asserts draftTelemetry buffer never grows past BUFFER_CAP=200 even when no token is present (today verified by code review only).
critical_code_review_comments: draftTelemetry.js public-mode silent drop — described above; HIGH severity for observability of the P0 fix.

DraftStatusPill.jsx returns null for status='idle' with no lastSavedAt — by design, but this means sibling pages render the pill ONLY after the first autosave write. The smoke regression test had to be relaxed accordingly. No action required, just noting that 'pill missing on fresh load' is correct behavior.
draft_telemetry.py /recent endpoint correctly excludes _id (verified by assertion in test_typing_triggers_draft_write_ok_telemetry).

useFormDraft.js return surface widened (pendingSavedAt, pendingIsCrossToken, lastSavedAt, lastError) — backward compatible because callers use object destructuring; verified by 4 sibling-form smoke tests.
test_credentials: Admin token obtained at runtime via POST /api/admin/login with ADMIN_PASSWORD from /app/backend/.env. Test seeds admin_token into localStorage for the telemetry integration test (needed because public-mode foremen lack tokens — see frontend_issues).
seed_data_creation: Each test injects synthetic IDB entries scoped to the device-id of that test browser; cleaned up by browser-context teardown. /api/draft-telemetry events emitted live to preview Mongo (TTL 30d on draft_telemetry_events collection) — no production impact, no manual cleanup required.
